description: Upload a template up to 5 MB: report Markdown/TXT/DOCX with {{title}} and/or {{findings}} placeholders; presentation 16:9 PPTX theme/layout. Send raw file bytes as base64; pass the returned template id to generate_research_output. Repeated uploads create separate templates.

data_base64.description: Raw file bytes encoded as standard base64; never a server path or URL.

organization_id.description: Platform admins only: select an organization for this operation. Required when changing another organization’s study or using its wallet.

name: upload_research_template
title: Upload Research Template
